description: MIST's own characteristics and its mapping into the stellariso unified vocabulary (definitions in registry/unified_parameters.json). Loaded and validated together with the definitions by stellariso.registry.
notes: Column meanings follow the official MIST table README (README_tables.pdf): the phase column is the FSPS phase type, and the same document defines the primary EEPs used as anchors.
MIST's RGB code (2) covers the subgiant branch and the RGB together; it maps to red_giant_branch rather than splitting it.
Phase 6 (postAGB) spans post-AGB through the white-dwarf cooling sequence; it maps to post_agb and must not be read as an enumerated WD population.
Mass-loss sign convention: star_mdot is negative while the star is losing mass. The unified mass_loss_rate is mapped only for MIST because of this signed convention.
current_mass context: MIST v1.2 uses Reimers-type RGB winds with efficiency anchored near eta ~ 0.1 and Blocker-type AGB winds.

references.citation: Choi, J., Dotter, A., Conroy, C., et al. 2016, ApJ, 823, 102
Paxton, B., et al. 2011, ApJS, 192, 3 (MESA I)

field_mappings.description: mass at age zero of the model whose isochrone point this row interpolates
actual (wind-reduced) mass at this point; MIST v1.2 uses Reimers-type RGB winds with efficiency anchored near eta ~ 0.1 and Blocker-type AGB winds
FSPS phase code as printed by MIST

field_mappings.transformation: MIST FSPS phase code mapped to unified coarse stages; codes 1, 7, 8 are not used by MIST

field_mappings.description: stellar mass-loss rate; negative means the star is losing mass (MIST sign convention)

phase_code_meanings.9: Wolf-Rayet (documented MS/WR overlap caution for very massive stars)

parameters.name: initial_feh
parameters.description: initial metallicity as [Fe/H]; the published v1.2 tarball suite uses a fixed set, form-generated files can be effectively continuous

parameters.name: initial_rotation
parameters.description: rotation values published for the MIST v1.2 isochrone suite (separate tarballs per v/vcrit); the header of each file states which one it holds

parameters.name: initial_helium
parameters.description: initial helium mass fraction (MIST Y-Z grid point)

parameters.name: initial_z
parameters.description: initial metal mass fraction (MIST Y-Z grid point)

parameters.name: mixing_length
parameters.description: MESA calibrates alpha_ML on the Sun; value not in data
